# cloudsmith_usage_limits (Data Source)

The usage limits data source reads the current on-demand usage settings and plan-specific maximum values for a Cloudsmith organization without managing them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

data "cloudsmith_usage_limits" "example" {
  organization = "my-organization"
}

output "package_delivery_limit" {
  value = data.cloudsmith_usage_limits.example.bandwidth_overage_limit
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The slug of the Cloudsmith organization whose usage limits are read.

### Read-Only

- `allow_open_source_overage` (Boolean) Whether on-demand open source usage is allowed.
- `bandwidth_maximum` (Number) The maximum package delivery overage allowed by the organization's plan, in GB.
- `bandwidth_overage_limit` (Number) The package delivery on-demand limit in GB.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `storage_maximum` (Number) The maximum artifact data overage allowed by the organization's plan, in GB.
- `storage_overage_limit` (Number) The artifact data on-demand limit in GB.
